title: Two Corruptions, the Word, and the Buds
description: T91 explains why the illumining principles within do not yet rejoice wholly: their understanding is fixed on the proprium and cannot look away — they see how it sets itself up as if it were ruler — and they are filled with concern for the living soul drawn taut between above and below, transferred from one bodily condition to the next. They will rejoice only when the living soul is refined and what calls itself her enemy is bound forever. T92 traces how interior truth takes outward form through five articulating degrees: the saying rises but the palate, tongue, teeth, lips, and breath shape it before it goes forth. Like a coin minted by five craftsmen, the word is adorned and given currency, fit to pass between minds. T93 shows how the same five degrees through which the Lord nourishes a new bud can become the means by which the proprium's shadow inundates and destroys the fruits — the remedy is in recognition and laying off, not in the elements themselves.
